name: dream
description: Periodic memory consolidation and self-improvement — "dream". Consolidates a one-fact-per-file memory store and surfaces recurring friction as proposed customizations to review.

interface.shortDescription: Consolidate memory and surface customization opportunities, once per interval.
interface.longDescription: Periodic memory consolidation, modeled on sleep: review what accumulated across recent sessions, keep what matters, reconcile contradictions, convert relative dates to absolute, and prune the stale — into a one-fact-per-file memory store. It also turns recurring friction into PROPOSED customizations for you to review (never self-authored). A deterministic script owns the 24h scheduling: a plugin-bundled Codex Stop hook queues a due dream, and a session-start AGENTS.md instruction launches /dream (a hook can't run an agentic skill); /dream also runs on demand.
capabilities: Once-per-interval memory consolidation into a one-fact-per-file store with a synced index
Deterministic transcript signal-gathering for durable facts, corrections, and preferences
Detection of recurring friction, surfaced as proposed customizations for review
Deterministic 24h scheduling via a zero-dependency script (no agent timekeeping)
Native Codex Stop hook to queue a due dream, plus a session-start AGENTS.md instruction to launch it
interface.defaultPrompt: Run a dream: consolidate my memory and surface any customization opportunities.
